messages.subject: getData( ) error
parts:

Thanks, Elizabeth

messages.author: 0e065001d5e74ca3
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] getData( ) error
parts:
Hi Elizabeth,

I suspect that getData() is complaining because argument 'indices' is a list
and not a vector. unlist() should fix it, although I note that if I don't
specify the fields to extract (e.g. getData(cs.orig, indices=1:10,
fields=c("intensities","stdvs")), I get errors. It seems to be specifically
related to trying to extract fields "x" or "y". Anyway, getData() in general
is designed to pull out columns from CEL files. Currently CEL files have 5
columns: x, y, intensities, stdvs, pixels. Extracting x or y seems redundant
if you are supplying indices (since they can be calculated with knowledge of
the number of rows and columns, which is in the CDF), but I guess they might
be needed by some low-level CEL file handling functions. I have never used x
or y, but frequently use getData() to grab the other 3 columns.

Cheers,

Ken
